subject: Compliance scoping & incident notification timeline — Northbridge pilot
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ariel Stone <ariel.stone@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & ask: SOC2/HIPAA scope + IR timeline for pilot

Hi Ariel —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and a short list of items that will help us scope the pilot and move the procurement/security review along: 

- SOC 2 posture: you mentioned an internal SOC program. Can you confirm whether you have a SOC 2 Type I or Type II report, and the expected date for Type II if not yet completed?
- Data classification / HIPAA: Please confirm whether any PHI will be routed to Redwood for the pilot. If so, we’ll need to start the HIPAA PIAs and BAAs discussion.
- GDPR applicability: do you have EU data subjects in the pilot? If yes, we’ll add data residency and DPA items to the questionnaire.
- Incident response / notification windows: we typically provide a draft IR timeline and examples of evidence. For procurement, customers often ask for notification commitments (e.g., initial acknowledgement within 24 hours, full incident timeline within 72 hours). Can you confirm if Northbridge has stricter internal SLAs?

Next steps I propose:
1) Please send your security contact the attached short questionnaire (one sheet) and the Northbridge security spreadsheet you referenced.
2) I’ll loop in our security lead (Kimberly) to map required evidence and propose a delivery timeline.
3) If PHI is in scope, we’ll start the BAA conversation in parallel.

Attaching a short artifact checklist for visibility — we can expand once Kimberly reviews.

Thanks,
Sean
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
(sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com)

Attachment: redwood_request_checklist.txt (text)
From: Ariel Stone <ariel.stone@northbridgehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@northbridgehealth.com>, legal@northbridgehealth.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & ask: SOC2/HIPAA scope + IR timeline for pilot

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the summary — helpful. A few quick answers: 

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type I (Dec 2025) and expect to complete Type II in Q3 2026. We can share the Type I report and our SOC roadmap.
- HIPAA/PHI: The pilot will include limited PHI (patient initials + appointment times in a small test dataset). We understand a BAA will be required.
- GDPR: Not in scope for the initial pilot — pilot data is US-only.
- Incident notification: We don’t have a stricter SLA than the 24/72 window you mentioned, but Legal prefers an initial notification within 24 hours and a follow-up factual timeline within 72 hours.

I’m attaching our security questionnaire (spreadsheet) — it’s the same one I referenced on the call. Marta (CISO) is looped for any technical follow-ups.

Could Kimberly share a preliminary list of the IR/BCP artifacts you would need and an estimated cadence for delivery? We’d like to confirm what can be handed over during the PO stage vs. after contract signature.

Best,
Ariel
Director of Product, Northbridge Health
ariel.stone@northbridgehealth.com

Attachment: northbridge_security_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up & ask: SOC2/HIPAA scope + IR timeline for pilot

Kimberly —

Forwarding Northbridge’s questionnaire (attached by Ariel). They confirmed Type I SOC (Dec 2025) and limited PHI in the pilot. Legal expects 24/72 notification windows. Can you review and propose:

- A concise evidence pack we can share pre-PO versus post-signature (sample runbooks, notification template, SOC artifact list)
- Estimated delivery timeline for each artifact once we have a PO/LOI (we should be specific: e.g., runbook sample within 3 business days, full IR playbook within 10 business days)
- Any gating items that might require legal negotiation (BAA, data residency assurances)

Ariel specifically asked what we can hand over before contract execution vs after. I’ve attached a short requested_artifacts list to speed review. 

Thanks — please let us know if you want a quick 20-min sync this week.

Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: requested_ir_artifacts_list.txt (txt)

Hi Ariel / Marta —

Thanks for the quick clarifications and for sharing the questionnaire. Below is a proposed scope of deliverables, delivery windows, and what we can provide before contract signature vs. after: 

What we can provide pre-PO (immediately / within 3 business days):
- Sample IR runbook excerpt (redacted): operational steps for containment and communication (Attachment: redwood_ir_runbook_excerpt.pdf)
- Incident notification template and escalation matrix (redwood_notification_template.docx)
- SOC 2 Type I summary (redacted) and our SOC roadmap (timeline toward Type II)

What we will provide post-signature (within contractually agreed windows):
- Full Incident Response playbook (delivery target: 10 business days after PO)
- BCP/DR summary and RTO/RPO statements (delivery target: 7 business days after PO)
- Signed BAA (if PHI confirmed in scope) — legal will coordinate
- For customers requesting deeper evidence (e.g., full SOC 2 Type II report when available), we can provide under NDA after Type II completion

Notification windows and commitments:
- Initial acknowledgement of suspected incident: within 24 hours of Redwood detection or customer report
- Preliminary factual update: within 72 hours with known scope and impact
- Final incident report: within 30 calendar days for standard incidents; for complex events we will provide milestone updates and a target closure estimate

Requested artifacts list (from your questionnaire) — what we expect to deliver and approximate timing:
- Network architecture diagram (redacted) — pre-PO sample within 3 business days
- Access control list and admin roster (redacted) — post-signature under NDA, delivery 7 business days
- Retention and deletion policy documentation — pre-PO sample available
- DR runbook and recovery test results — post-signature (7-10 business days)

If that timeline looks reasonable, Monica/Sean can include these commitments in the SOW draft. If you prefer, we can convert the pre-PO samples into a short NDA'd evidence package and agree on delivery dates in the LOI.

Attachments: redwood_ir_playbook_summary.pdf (pdf), redwood_ir_runbook_excerpt.pdf (pdf), redwood_notification_template.docx (docx)

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call with Marta this week to align — I’m available Wed/Thu afternoon PST.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security & Trust Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
